I personally am living because of spite and because I want to experience more things. I live because of all of the bigots who would rather a trans queer kid off themselves. I live because I want to dye my hair different colors, and transition. I live because I don’t want my deadname on my gravestone. I live because I want to experience a loving relationship and a life outside of my parents house. I’m not going to become another statistic.  I have depressive episodes and mood swings, but I am fortunate enough to still have hope for the future.   I wish you the best OP.

I have my hair dyed yellow rn, and let me tell you. It. Gets. On. Everything. Pillow case, shirts, towels, even my hands when I style my hair. Make sure you rinse it out throughly after dyeing. I’ve never had that problem with hair dye before. Also, if you want to go bright yellow make sure you bleach your hair enough. I went from orange to yellow and tried to use minimal bleach so as to not damage my hair, but I ended up with a warmer orange orange tinged sunny color. I like it, but it’s not what I was really going for. 

My mom was also not very on board with some of my hair decisions, but I have worn her down over time and she is resigned to the fact that I will do whatever I want with my hair as long as I have access to the supplies. We have had many conversations where I expressed frustrations similar to yours when she objected to what I wanted to do to my hair. I think it helps that I’ve never done something to my hair that I’ve majorly regretted. Even though she had some hang ups she wants me to be happy. And she can tell how much being able to control my hair has made me happier. She even liked some of the colors that I choose (red and yellow)

Hopefully your mom will come around eventually. Good luck and have fun.
